pi_invariant.exact_predicate: SAT(F_g) is preserved by the composed relation, and whenever the composed decision is SAT the relation can reconstruct a model for the original F_g that independently satisfies every original source clause.
pi_invariant.complexity_attachment: For terminal G, preservation alone is insufficient: relation size, composition size, and all required runtime must remain polynomial in |F_g|.
pi_invariant.note: The complexity obligation is attached to G but is not itself the semantic pi predicate.
